schema_note: HF ids are '<owner>/<name>'. kind is implied by the key (models/datasets/spaces). repos are public GitHub repos only. Private repos are never linked. 'inferred' marks a link the HF card does not state outright.

themes.title: English-Hebrew code-switching
themes.summary: ASR and text models for English speech and text that contain Hebrew words, plus the datasets they were trained on.

projects.title: Parakeet TDT 0.6B v2 code-switching fine-tune
projects.summary: Parakeet v2 fine-tuned on one speaker reading English sentences with Hebrew words. Ships the NeMo original plus per-format repos: GGUF (Handy, Android), ONNX (onnx-asr, Voxtype) and sherpa-onnx int8.

projects.title: English-Hebrew code-switching ASR benchmark
projects.summary: Frozen test set (v1, 145 clips) and leaderboard for ASR on English speech with Hebrew words. Headline metric is Hebrew term recall on an 84-clip clean subset that overlaps no published training set.

projects.title: Hebrew-in-Latin token classifier
projects.summary: XLM-R token classifier that finds romanized Hebrew words inside English text. Span F1 0.941 on a term-disjoint test split.

projects.title: Whisper-Hebrish
projects.summary: The first code-switching fine-tune: Whisper large-v3-turbo on English sentences with Hebrew words. Its dataset is superseded and has substring-matched labels (114 of 474 wrong).

themes.title: Personal ASR fine-tunes (Whisper)
themes.summary: Whisper fine-tuned on about an hour of my own voice, for local dictation. Includes FUTO-compatible ACFT variants and the evaluations that compared them with commercial APIs.

projects.title: Whisper fine-tunes v2 (tiny to large-v3-turbo)
projects.summary: Five sizes fine-tuned on about 1 hour of my voice with technical vocabulary. GGML and CTranslate2 conversions are included.
projects.notes: The model cards say 'unknown dataset'. The TechVoice dataset matches the described training data but is not confirmed as the source.

projects.title: Whisper ACFT fine-tunes (FUTO keyboard)

projects.title: Fine-tune evaluations

projects.title: Tech Sentences (2026 recording set)
